sources.name: World Bank 2023 flare inventory
sources.note: VIIRS-derived annual gas estimates; uniform hourly activity assumption.

sources.name: ERA5 via Open-Meteo
sources.note: Nine returned grid locations, 100 m winds; 8,760 UTC hours.

sources.name: US Census ACS 2019–2023
sources.note: 763 tracts; 5 km uniform area allocation conserves population. Places overlap tracts.

sources.name: EIA/NETL pipeline geometry
sources.note: Distance proxy only; no confirmed access or capacity.

sources.name: EIA Henry Hub via FRED
sources.note: 249 observed 2023 daily prices; benchmark, not site netback.

basis.benchmark_price: Observed mean of 249 available 2023 Henry Hub daily prices; not site netback.
basis.economic_coefficients: All capture, sellable fraction, heating value, cost, lifetime and discount coefficients are explicit screening assumptions, not measured site composition or installation quotes.
basis.pipeline_distance: Nearest downloaded line segment; no evidence of feasible access, capacity, rights, or construction route. Geometry vintage is not established as 2023.
basis.volume: Satellite-estimated 2023 annual gas; constant annual baseline, not observed hourly operation.
basis.payback: Simple undiscounted capex / first-year positive margin; not a claim payback occurs within project life.
basis.edge_effect: Flag if nearest downloaded segment is farther than the clipped-data boundary. Unflagged distances exclude only clipping edge effects, not missing inventory.

analysis_coverage.aggregation: arithmetic mean of all hourly source contributions

limitations: 2023 satellite-estimated annual flare volumes; not current operations or metered flow.
2019–2023 ACS population is a five-year estimate, not a census on each playback date.
Population is tract-level; the 5 km grid uses uniform area allocation, not observed residential locations.
Nine sampled ERA5 cells are a coarse weather mesh, not street-level wind.
Pipeline geometry is context only; availability, capacity, tie-in permission and costs unknown.
Capture efficiency, installation cost, operating cost and project life remain scenario assumptions.
Smoke-test exposure is a relative screening calculation, not concentration or health risk.
rounding: Browser arrays six significant digits; numerical artifacts retain full precision.
